_: Name, description and badge live in src/resources/connectors.json so the console and the browser process cannot disagree about them.

notes: A personal token is the simpler path for one workspace and is what Flux offers first; OAuth is for connecting more than one account or for a build shared with other people.

Slack splits bot and user scopes. The list above is bot scopes, sent as `scope`; anything that must act as the human goes in `user_scope` and comes back as a separate authed_user token in the same response.
Send client_id and client_secret with HTTP Basic rather than as form parameters - Slack recommends it explicitly.
oauth.v2.access returns HTTP 200 on failure with {"ok": false, "error": ...}. Checking the status code alone will treat a rejected exchange as a success.
chat:write is the only write scope requested and it is what makes posting possible at all; a read-only task must not be given a token carrying it.

personal_token.label: Bot User OAuth Token
personal_token.where: api.slack.com/apps > your app > OAuth & Permissions. Add the scopes first, then Install to Workspace; the token appears at the top of that page afterwards.
notes: A User OAuth Token (xoxp-) is also issued and is the one that can search - search.messages does not work with a bot token.
The "Generate Token" button on the Your Apps index is an App Configuration Token for managing apps programmatically. It is not this, and it will not work here.

search_messages.notes: Requires a user token, not a bot token - bots cannot search.

post_message.notes: Visible to other people the moment it succeeds. Never reachable from a readonly or draft task.

rate_limits.note: Tiered per method, roughly 1/min to 100/min, returned as 429 with Retry-After. conversations.history is Tier 3; search.messages is Tier 2 and is the one that bites.

notes: The authorize URL and the API base are read out of Slack's own SDKs - install-provider.ts hard-codes https://slack.com/oauth/v2/authorize and base_client.py hard-codes https://slack.com/api/ - rather than from documentation about them.
